title: AI Lifestyle Photos for Wellness Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one wellness product photo into lifestyle photos and creator-style ads for routines, product pages and social feeds. Watermark-free files ready to post.
h1: AI Lifestyle Photos for Wellness Brands, Set in a Real Routine
lead: A plain packshot does not show when the product is used. Paste a product link or one photo, and set it in a morning routine without a claim about the body.
card: Routine stills and short clips for supplements, tea, and gear.

faq.q: Can the photo or clip show what a supplement does?
faq.a: Show how and when it is used, not a health result. Keep claims and dosage in text your team approves, and skip any scene that implies a body change.

faq.q: Why does the label look washed out?
faq.a: Shoot the bottle upright, front label centered, with soft side light instead of a direct flash. Glare usually starts in that source photo.

faq.q: Can I use these in paid wellness ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use, including paid ads. Any health claim or offer you add has to be accurate.

faq.q: Do I need a model or a creator?
faq.a: No hire for these scenes. Pick a generated presenter, and the clip can include a spoken line and captions. Hire a real person only for a true customer story. Health claims stay in copy you can check.

faq.q: Can I make a Story from this?
faq.a: Yes. A square still fits a feed or a product page. For a vertical Story, make a 9:16 clip at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Which frames can a clip use?
faq.a: Video frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Pick the one the placement already uses.
Avoid before-and-after bodies, medical outcomes, and dosage text inside the image. Show the product in a routine, and write the claims where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one cut?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send that link through the API. Ask for a short script, pick a presenter, and make a few cuts, including one in another language. Trim the clip, choose a voice and a backing track, and check captions in the editor on the page, then send it to TikTok or Meta. The credit cost is shown before you start. Do not show a health result.
